description: This file defines a Java interface 'WithResource' which specifies methods related to retrieving resource path and resource type, representing an entity associated with a resource within the system.

classes.name: WithResource
classes.description: A Java interface representing entities associated with a resource, providing methods to access resource path and type.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the path of the resource represented by the entity, as a JsonPointer.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource represented by the entity as a String.
